purpose: Resolve or formally document the policy metadata discrepancy.
required_evidence: Root-cause record, authoritative policy reference, versioned artifacts, and independent validation.
proposed_exit_criteria: No unexplained policy-status inconsistency remains in the approved decision package.

purpose: Confirm the return, exposure, turnover, and risk calculations.
required_evidence: Independent reproduction and documented formula review.
proposed_exit_criteria: All selected checks reconcile within predeclared tolerances.

purpose: Assess whether the relative result survives more realistic costs.
required_evidence: Reviewed cost model with documented inclusions and exclusions.
proposed_exit_criteria: Cost assumptions are defensible for the intended implementation and results are independently reproduced.

purpose: Test stability beyond the currently evaluated historical sample.
required_evidence: Predeclared evaluation design, untouched data, and leakage checks.
proposed_exit_criteria: Results meet decision criteria specified before the test and include documented unfavorable outcomes.

purpose: Demonstrate handling of data failures and operational exceptions.
required_evidence: Runbook, simulated failure tests, monitoring, alerts, and rollback procedures.
proposed_exit_criteria: Required failure cases are detected and handled according to approved procedures.

purpose: Collect non-live operational evidence after prior gates pass.
required_evidence: Approved trial protocol, timestamped signals, incident logs, and a completed review.
proposed_exit_criteria: Trial criteria set in advance are satisfied and reviewed before any separate deployment decision.
